warnings: stock_issued: 2 derived quarter(s) (2018-12-31, 2020-06-30) came out negative — the fiscal-year (or year-to-date) figure and the leg subtracted from it are on different bases (a restatement, reclassification or discontinued operations); not shown

eps_diluted: 1 period(s) (2016-12-31..2016-12-31) carry no EPS tag — the filed continuing-operations EPS (IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerDilutedShare) is shown, only where the period reports no discontinued operations

eps_basic: 1 period(s) (2016-12-31..2016-12-31) carry no EPS tag — the filed continuing-operations EPS (IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerBasicShare) is shown, only where the period reports no discontinued operations

debt: 33 cell(s) where two debt lines are the same filed fact (same value, date and filing under two tags) are counted once — e.g. 2025-12-31 short_term_debt (DebtCurrent) = current_lt_debt (LongTermDebtCurrent) = 13,800,000; the current_lt_debt cell is blank

interest expense: the row mixes gross and NET figures, so it keeps the label "Interest expense"; net (income inside) for 33 period(s) 2017-03-31..2026-06-30 — including 2 filed under the gross tag whose value equals minus the filer's net interest tag for that period

quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): interest_expense 2017-12-31, interest_expense 2018-12-31, interest_expense 2019-12-31, interest_expense 2020-12-31, interest_expense 2021-12-31, other_nonoperating 2019-12-31, other_nonoperating 2020-12-31, other_nonoperating 2021-12-31, other_nonoperating 2022-12-31, other_nonoperating 2023-12-31, other_nonoperating 2024-12-31, other_nonoperating 2025-12-31...

income statement: the operating lines shown for FY ending 2025-12-31 explain 2,424,000,000 of the 3,276,300,000 between revenue and operating income — the filer tags its other operating lines with custom elements that EDGAR companyfacts does not carry

restricted cash: in 22 period(s), 2020-03-31..2026-06-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 22 period(s), 2020-03-31..2026-06-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

free cash flow: 11 period(s) (2022-12-31..2026-03-31) report discontinued operations' investing cash flows on their own line, so capex is continuing-only there — FCF and owner's earnings use continuing OCF (NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations, else OCF − CashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesDiscontinuedOperations from the same filing), blank where neither is filed; the OCF line itself stays the filed total
net margin: continuing net income ÷ revenue for 13 period(s) with discontinued operations (2022-12-31..2026-06-30) — revenue is continuing-only there

growth across filing generations: 32 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): accounts_payable (2023-12-31); capex (2022-12-31); change_inventory (2022-12-31); change_payables (2022-12-31); change_receivables (2022-12-31); cost_of_revenue (2022-12-31); current_lease (2023-12-31); da (2022-12-31); deferred_tax_assets (2023-12-31); deferred_tax_liab (2023-12-31); ebitda (2022-12-31); goodwill (2022-12-31); ...

shifted column: 3 tag-period(s) where only the newest filing(s) carry the adjacent period's exact value (a mis-dated context, not a restatement); the earlier filings' value is kept: GrossProfit 2017-10-01..2017-12-31: kept 2.134e+08, ignored 2.187e+08 = the 2018-12-31 value (10-K filed 2020-02-25); OperatingIncomeLoss 2017-10-01..2017-12-31: kept 5.94e+07, ignored 8.62e+07 = the 2018-12-31 value (10-K filed 2020-02-25); RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax 2017-10-01..2017-12-31: kept 5.419e+08, ignored 5.681e+08 = the 2018-12-31 value (10-K filed 2020-02-25)
